strategies.name: Quality Compounders
strategies.summary: Owns durable franchises that reinvest at high incremental returns. Edge comes from underestimation of compounding duration and the market's tendency to discount terminal value too aggressively in volatile periods. Fails when multiple compression dominates earnings power, typically in sharp rate-shock or deleveraging regimes.
strategies.universe: Large/mid-cap US equities with ROIC > 15%, FCF margin > 12%, debt/EBITDA < 2x, gross margin stability over 5y
strategies.review_rule: Monthly fundamental refresh; drawdown alert at -15% triggers re-underwrite of moat thesis
strategies.evidence_gate: Three+ consecutive quarters of stable ROIC and FCF conversion with no capital allocation drift

strategies.name: Deep Value Rerating
strategies.summary: Buys statistically cheap names where catalysts (capital return, asset sale, mgmt change, cycle turn) plausibly close the gap to intrinsic value within 12-24 months. Edge is in pairing valuation with a hard catalyst rather than waiting passively. Fails in value traps and during persistent growth-led regimes where cheapness alone does not mean-revert.
strategies.universe: US equities EV/EBIT < 8x, P/TBV < 1.5x, positive FCF, market cap > $300M, with identifiable catalyst
strategies.review_rule: Quarterly thesis review; exit if catalyst window slips beyond 24 months or thesis breaks
strategies.evidence_gate: Concrete catalyst identified (filing, announcement, insider activity) plus valuation in bottom quintile

strategies.name: GARP with Estimate Revisions
strategies.summary: Combines reasonable valuation with positive analyst estimate revisions, exploiting the tendency of revisions to cluster (analysts anchor and update slowly). Edge is in catching the second and third revision after the first surprise. Fails when revisions reverse en masse during macro-driven earnings resets.
strategies.universe: US equities with PEG < 1.5, sales growth > 10%, positive 30d EPS revision breadth
strategies.review_rule: Bi-weekly revision sweep; exit when 30d revision breadth flips negative for two consecutive periods
strategies.evidence_gate: Net positive revision breadth on both EPS and sales, plus PEG below sector median

strategies.name: Momentum with Breadth Confirmation
strategies.summary: Long the strongest 12-1 month momentum names, gated by market breadth (advance-decline, % above 200d MA) to avoid late-cycle thrust failures. Edge is the breadth filter: classic momentum suffers worst when breadth narrows. Fails in sharp regime changes (vol spikes, credit shocks) where momentum reverses violently.
strategies.universe: Top decile 12-1 month total return, liquidity > $20M ADV, price > 200d MA
strategies.review_rule: Weekly momentum re-rank; reduce gross when breadth thrust indicators decay
strategies.evidence_gate: Top-decile momentum plus market breadth above 60% of stocks over 200d MA

strategies.name: Low Volatility Defensive
strategies.summary: Owns lowest-vol quintile equities for risk-adjusted outperformance and drawdown protection. Edge is the low-vol anomaly plus implicit quality tilt. Fails during sharp risk-on rotations and rate shocks (bond-proxy correlation), and underperforms in strong leveraging regimes.
strategies.universe: Bottom quintile 252d realized vol, dividend yield > 1.5%, market cap > $1B
strategies.review_rule: Monthly vol re-rank; trim if rate vol spikes (MOVE index regime change)
strategies.evidence_gate: Sustained bottom-quintile vol over 6+ months with stable dividend

strategies.name: Hard Asset Carry
strategies.summary: Long real-asset producers (energy, metals, agri, infra) when forward curves are in backwardation and real yields are subdued. Edge is positive roll yield plus inflation hedge. Fails in disinflationary deleveraging where commodity demand collapses faster than supply adjusts.
strategies.universe: Energy, metals, agri equities and commodity ETFs; forward curve backwardation > 2%
strategies.review_rule: Monthly review of curve shape and real yield regime; exit when backwardation fades or DXY breaks higher
strategies.evidence_gate: Backwardation plus negative or flat real 10y plus stable/weakening dollar

strategies.name: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
strategies.summary: Long large positive surprises with positive guide-up, short large negative surprises with guide-down, holding 30-60 days. Edge is slow analyst incorporation and passive flow lag. Fails when macro shocks dominate idiosyncratic earnings signal or when crowded into systematic books.
strategies.universe: US equities with earnings surprise > 2 std dev and same-direction revision flow
strategies.review_rule: Hold 30-60 days post-print; exit on revision reversal or 50% gap fill
strategies.evidence_gate: Surprise magnitude > 2sd, same-direction guide, and confirming first-week price action

strategies.name: Insider Buying with Short Interest Squeeze
strategies.summary: Long names with cluster insider buying when short interest is elevated and days-to-cover stretched. Edge is informational asymmetry (insiders) plus mechanical squeeze risk. Fails when insider buys are tax/optical and fundamentals deteriorate, or when dealer hedging is one-sided.
strategies.universe: US equities with 3+ insider buys in 90d, short interest > 10% float, days-to-cover > 5
strategies.review_rule: Re-evaluate weekly; exit if insider activity reverses or borrow normalizes
strategies.evidence_gate: Insider cluster + SI > 10% + DTC > 5 + no fundamental impairment

strategies.name: Credit-Stress Value
strategies.summary: Buys high-quality issuers whose equities are oversold during HY spread-widening episodes that do not threaten the issuer's solvency. Edge is the equity market's overreaction to credit signals at the issuer level. Fails when credit stress evolves into systemic deleveraging that drags all risk assets regardless of issuer quality.
strategies.universe: IG/crossover issuers with debt/EBITDA < 3x, interest coverage > 5x, equities down > 25% during HY spread spikes
strategies.review_rule: Monitor HY OAS daily; sized positions only when spread peaks and starts compressing
strategies.evidence_gate: Spread widening > 150bp from local low + issuer balance sheet remains investment grade + equity drawdown > 25%

strategies.name: Relative Value Pairs
strategies.summary: Long/short within tightly cointegrated pairs (sector-peer, holdco-stub, dual-listed) when spread exceeds historical bands. Edge is mean reversion in fundamentally linked pairs. Fails on regime breaks where the relationship structurally changes (M&A, divergent capital structures).
strategies.universe: Cointegrated equity pairs within sector, ADR/local pairs, holdco/stub structures
strategies.review_rule: Daily spread monitoring; exit on cointegration break or idiosyncratic catalyst
strategies.evidence_gate: Spread z-score > 2 with stable cointegration over trailing 252d

strategies.name: Convex Tail Hedge
strategies.summary: Persistent allocation to OTM index puts and VIX call spreads sized to monetize during > 2 std dev events. Edge is convex payoff during deleveraging cascades when correlations go to one. Fails (bleeds) in long vol-compression regimes where carry cost dominates and theta erodes the book.
strategies.universe: SPX/NDX OTM puts (5-15% OTM, 30-90 DTE), VIX call spreads, put ratios
strategies.review_rule: Monthly roll; size up when skew is cheap relative to realized risk regime
strategies.evidence_gate: Skew below 30th percentile + benign credit + elevated systematic gross = increase hedge

strategies.name: Volatility Carry (Short Vol)
strategies.summary: Systematically sells index variance / VIX futures when implied exceeds realized by a meaningful premium and term structure is in contango. Edge is the well-documented variance risk premium. Fails catastrophically in vol-spike regimes; must be paired with a hard tail hedge or strict stop discipline.
strategies.universe: VIX futures, SPX variance swaps proxies, short-dated index strangles
strategies.review_rule: Daily monitoring of term structure; full exit on backwardation or RV > IV signal
strategies.evidence_gate: Contango > 5% + IV-RV spread > 3 vol points + benign credit regime

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Trend Following
strategies.summary: Long/short trend signals across equity indices, rates, FX, and commodities using ensemble breakout/MA-cross signals. Edge is positive crisis-alpha and persistence in macro trends. Fails in choppy mean-reverting regimes (whipsaw) and at sharp regime turns (CTA reversal episodes).
strategies.universe: Liquid futures across equities, rates, FX, commodities; ETF proxies for retail
strategies.review_rule: Weekly signal recompute; vol-target position sizing; reduce gross when correlation across assets spikes
strategies.evidence_gate: Aligned trend signals on at least two timeframes plus stable cross-asset vol regime

strategies.name: Breadth Thrust Momentum
strategies.summary: Goes risk-on after rare breadth-thrust signals (Zweig, % above 50d crossing 90, advance-decline thrust) that historically mark durable bottoms. Edge is the empirical persistence of these signals over 6-12 months. Fails when thrusts occur inside ongoing credit stress that the equity market hasn't priced.
strategies.universe: US equity index ETFs (SPY/QQQ/IWM) and high-beta sector ETFs
strategies.review_rule: Quarterly review post-trigger; minimum 6-month hold unless credit signals fail
strategies.evidence_gate: Confirmed thrust trigger + benign or improving credit + VIX peak with structure flip

strategies.name: Post-FOMC Drift
strategies.summary: Trades the well-documented equity drift in the days following FOMC meetings, with direction conditional on the surprise component (hawkish vs dovish vs aligned). Edge is sluggish risk-asset repricing of policy stance. Fails when meetings coincide with broader macro shocks that swamp the policy signal.
strategies.universe: SPX/NDX index futures and ETFs, rate-sensitive sectors (utilities, REITs, banks)
strategies.review_rule: Position sized at FOMC close; hold 5-15 trading days; exit on macro shock or yield reversal
strategies.evidence_gate: Clear surprise direction in funds curve plus same-direction yield move plus no offsetting macro release

strategies.name: Options Skew Arbitrage
strategies.summary: Trades extreme readings in single-name and index put-call skew, fading historical 99th-percentile skew when fundamentals do not support the implied tail. Edge is the tendency of skew to mean-revert post hedging-flow exhaustion. Fails when skew extremes are early warnings of fundamental rerating.
strategies.universe: Liquid index and single-name options with > 10k OI on tested strikes
strategies.review_rule: Daily monitoring; exit on skew normalization or fundamental confirmation of risk
strategies.evidence_gate: Skew > 95th percentile + no near-term catalyst + stable issuer fundamentals

strategies.name: Short Squeeze Setup
strategies.summary: Identifies high-short-interest names with positive options flow, dealer short gamma, and emerging fundamental tailwind to play mechanical short-covering plus gamma feedback. Edge is the convex payoff when forced covering meets dealer hedging. Fails when fundamentals deteriorate faster than positioning unwinds.
strategies.universe: US equities with SI > 15% float, borrow > 5%, days-to-cover > 5, positive call volume skew
strategies.review_rule: Daily monitoring; exit on borrow normalization or thesis break
strategies.evidence_gate: SI > 15% + DTC > 5 + bullish call flow + no balance sheet impairment

strategies.name: Sector Rotation by Cycle
strategies.summary: Rotates sector exposure based on the prevailing growth/inflation regime (early/mid/late/recession quadrants) using leading indicators and yield-curve signals. Edge is the persistence of sector leadership inside regimes. Fails at regime turning points when leadership rotates faster than indicators confirm.
strategies.universe: US sector ETFs (XLK, XLF, XLE, XLI, XLP, XLY, XLV, XLU, XLB, XLC, XLRE)
strategies.review_rule: Monthly regime classification; rotate sector tilts on confirmed quadrant change
strategies.evidence_gate: Two consecutive months of consistent regime-quadrant signals across leading indicators

strategies.name: Defensive Rotation Late Cycle
strategies.summary: Tilts portfolio toward staples, healthcare, utilities, and quality bonds when late-cycle indicators (curve inversion, weakening labor, credit-spread widening) align. Edge is reducing drawdown ahead of cyclical rollover while staying invested. Fails when policy interventions extend the cycle or when defensives have already crowded.
strategies.universe: Staples, healthcare, utilities ETFs and high-quality dividend equities; short-duration IG credit
strategies.review_rule: Monthly review of late-cycle dashboard; scale rotation in stages on confirmed deterioration
strategies.evidence_gate: Three or more late-cycle indicators flashing concurrently with credit confirmation

strategies.name: Index Dispersion Trade
strategies.summary: Long single-name volatility, short index volatility, expressed via variance swaps or strangle baskets to harvest the implied correlation premium. Edge is the chronic richness of index implied correlation versus realized. Fails in correlation-spike regimes where index vol re-rates faster than single-name vol.
strategies.universe: Top 50 SPX components vs SPX index options, weighted to neutralize vega
strategies.review_rule: Bi-weekly rebalance of vega weights; exit on correlation spike or basket dispersion collapse
strategies.evidence_gate: Implied correlation > 80th percentile relative to realized correlation regime
